title: DP branch: two towers x 10 seeds (FLAG train + MAV-Celeb v1/v2, 58 Bengali-flagged MAV voice files dropped), out-of-fold z constants, English Evaluation scores, tower checkpoint

local_run.determinism: re-run 21:52-22:03 gave bit-identical English scores (S8 K6)

inputs.note: eval_set.zip, the zip the DP branch read on 16/11; when only the extracted dataset view is available the stage rebuilds the zip; either way its members are checked against stages/10_raw/raw_evalphase/expected/eval_set_members.sha256

outputs.notes: dp_train_check.json records the sha256 of the DP Evaluation feature files used (eval_feats_sha256); stage dp_score reads it

verify.rule: bit equality shown only on the team machine (S8 K6); elsewhere report max |dz| and Spearman

xjf.py.old: import io, json, sys, time, zipfile
xjf.py.new: import io, json, os, sys, time, zipfile
xjf.py.why: os is needed to read the path variables below

xjf.py.old: HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent; REPO = HERE.parents[1]; KO = REPO / "kaggle" / "output"
xjf.py.new: HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent; REPO = HERE.parents[1]; KO = Path(os.environ.get("DP_FEATS", REPO / "kaggle" / "output"))   # FF repo: dp_feats folder
xjf.py.why: feature arrays come from stage dp_feats_layout (same file names and sub-folders as kaggle/output/)

xjf.py.new: OUT = Path(os.environ.get("DP_OUT", HERE / "out")); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)   # FF repo: output folder
xjf.py.why: the stage folder is read-only; output goes to the stage's working folder

xjf.py.new: tz = zipfile.ZipFile(os.environ.get("DP_TRAIN_ZIP", REPO / "Input" / "train_set.zip"))   # FF repo: organisers' train_set.zip

xjf.py.why: organisers' meta_file_train_set.csv (gender of the 70 train persons) from FF_DATA/00_raw/btc_mavceleb_v4
lid_strict.json (58 MAV voice files flagged Bengali) from stage l_lid_strict / dataset ngnnguynchn/flag2027-lid-strict-p
xjf.py.effect_on_numbers: none (sha256 f4065711... checked by the stage)

xjf.py.why: Evaluation features come from stage dp_extract_eval

xjf.py.old: ms = [train(s, np.arange(len(t_pid))) for s in SEEDS]; log("final models:", len(ms), "last losses", [round(m[2], 3) for m in ms[:3]])
xjf.py.new:
ms = [train(s, np.arange(len(t_pid))) for s in SEEDS]; log("final models:", len(ms), "last losses", [round(m[2], 3) for m in ms[:3]])
# FF repo (save): checkpoint of the 10 final tower pairs + the constants needed to score from it (stage dp_score).
# Nothing here draws a random number or changes a model or an input: every score below is unchanged.
torch.save({"format": "FourFusion DP two-tower checkpoint v1", "seeds": list(SEEDS), "dims": [int(TF.shape[1]), int(TV.shape[1])],
            "towers": [{"face": f.state_dict(), "voice": v.state_dict()} for f, v, _ in ms],
            "MU_F": torch.from_numpy(MU_F.copy()), "MU_V": torch.from_numpy(MU_V.copy()),
            "CONST": {k: [float(a), float(b)] for k, (a, b) in CONST.items()}}, OUT / "dp_towers.pt")
print("saved", OUT / "dp_towers.pt", flush=True)
xjf.py.why: the original kept the 10 trained tower pairs only in memory (no checkpoint, gap G5); the organisers ask for checkpoints
xjf.py.effect_on_numbers: none: train() re-seeds torch and numpy itself (torch.manual_seed(seed), default_rng(seed)); state_dict() / torch.save draw no random number and do not touch the models; print() keeps report.txt as before

env_spec: docker/requirements-dp-local.txt (team CPU machine: Python 3.14.0, torch 2.12.1+cpu, numpy 2.3.5, pandas 3.0.5, insightface 2.0, onnxruntime 1.31.1, speechbrain 1.1.2; S8 E3)

env_overrides.DP_EVAL_ZIP: path of eval_set.zip (else the raw_evalphase output, else rebuilt from the evalphase view; members checked)
env_overrides.DP_ALLOW_INPUT_MISMATCH: 1 = go on when an input differs from the submission's: lid_strict.json not version 2, a saved dp_feats copy whose files differ from dp_features.json, eval_set.zip members that differ from the submitted zip
env_overrides.DP_TMP: scratch folder (unpacked media, rebuilt zips, model copies); default FF_WORK/tmp, emptied at every run (<base>/ff_dp/<stage>)
env_overrides.DP_FEATS_DIR: folder holding feats_v2/, feats_models/, feats_eval/, feats_ext_full/ with the 20 files of dp_feats_layout/dp_features.json (else found by structure in the dp_feats_layout input)
